outcome: Plan-mode and grill discipline are now gates the recorders enforce, not reminders. A PostToolUse hook records who authored every plan (plan-mode markers) and every question actually put to a human (AskUserQuestion rounds with chosen answers); plan and task-plan save/approve refuse a plan without a matching marker, and spec, requirements, plan and task grills refuse rounds not in the ledger, below the per-gate floor, or missing the frontier-empty attestation. The task loop runs plan, then grill, then human approval, then stage start — printed by forge next and pinned by tests. A session can no longer save a plan authored outside plan mode or record a grill that never asked a human anything; the story proved it on itself, its own gates refusing its own plan and grill until done right.
